verdict.rationale: Docs claim the SDK is built on the same foundation as Claude Code, exposing the same tools, agent loop, hooks, skills, subagents, MCP, permissions, and session management that power the UI/CLI (docs-1, docs-31, docs-51). However, some Claude Code UI-level orchestration features (agent view, agent teams) are documented only as CLI screens, not explicitly exposed as SDK/API primitives, and community reports note billing/policy distinctions that restrict how SDK-based apps can use a Claude subscription compared to CLI usage. missing for 10: explicit API equivalents for CLI-only surfaces like 'agent view' and 'agent teams', and independent confirmation that full UI parity holds in practice.
